spans.s: नैयग्रोधम् [naiyagrōdham], The fruit of न्यग्रोध, the Indian fig-tree.
नैयमिक [naiyamika], a. (-की f.) Conformable to rule or precept, regular. -कम् Regularity.
नैयाय [naiyāya], a. Treating of, or explaining the Nyāya philosophy.
नैयायिकः [naiyāyikḥ], A logician, a follower of the Nyāya system of philosophy; नैयायिकानां तु नये ह्यणुकादावपीष्यते Bhāṣā P.
